name: Hori
overview: The name Hori appears in Scripture in two distinct genealogical contexts: as a son of Lotan, a descendant associated with the land of Seir, and as a Simeonite, the father of Shaphat. Genesis 36 records Hori among the children of Lotan and notes that several chiefs descended from him in Seir, highlighting his place within Edomite leadership. Additionally, Numbers 13 identifies a Simeonite named Hori as the father of Shaphat, linking the name to the tribe of Simeon and its role in Israel's wilderness period.
